blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video gaze prediction is led by gaze-trained models, yet gaze-free priors carry signal those models have not absorbed, if one knows when to trust them. We propose FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors whose members may abstain. A per-frame gate reads three shape statistics of a defocus map and selects the frames on which the estimator is above chance on average, so rejected frames reduce to the base exactly, while midrank normalisation lets an all-zero prior abstain at zero parameters. Gated fusion is significantly positive on film, sports and web video, whereas unconditional fusion is harmful on sports and null on web. Added to four supervised predictors, the NTIRE 2026 champion among them, FocusGate improves all sixteen model–domain cells in shuffled AUC, fifteen significantly, one domain pre-registered and scored once, while adding only 1% to the champion’s latency. Alone, it surpasses TASED-Net and UNISAL in shuffled AUC on film with a 16-frame causal mean.
blocks.zh: 视频目光预测是由目光训练模型所引导的,然而无目光前传则携带着这些模型没有被吸收的信号,如果人们知道何时可以相信它们的话. 我们提议FocusGate, 一个有门的无目光的前科组合, 其成员可以弃权。 每帧门读取了去聚焦图的三个形状统计,并选择了估计器平均高于概率的帧,因此被否决的帧完全缩小到基数上,而中位态的正态化则让一个在零参数上全0前弃权. 在电影、体育和网络视频中,加特聚变明显阳性,而无条件聚变则有害于体育,在网络上是无效的。 其中NTIRE 2026年的冠军FocusGate在四个受监督的预测者之外,还改进了被洗牌的AUC中所有16个模型-域名细胞,其中15个显著,一个域名预先注册并得分一次,同时只给冠军的休息时间增加了1%. 仅此而已,它就超越了TASED-Net和UNISAL,在影片中用16个框架的因果平均值对AUC进行洗牌。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Filmmakers keep the narratively relevant region in focus, and eye-tracking studies confirm that blur contrast steers fixations [ 23 , 30 ] . Modern video saliency is dominated by trained networks [ 15 , 7 , 17 , 28 , 19 , 18 ] , yet the explicit priors
used to compose and interpret such systems have hardly changed: a centre Gaussian, faces [ 24 ] , motion [ 16 ] . Focusness has served salient-object detection in static images [ 31 ] , and blur identification has been
injected into saliency models before [ 2 ] , but always unconditionally. Reliability-aware fusion has precedents [ 1 , 4 ] , but whether such priors still add anything beside gaze-trained models, and on which frames, has not been asked.
blocks.zh:
电影制作者将叙事相关区域作为重点,而眼线跟踪研究证实模糊的对比会引导定型[23,30]. 现代视频的显著性以训练有素的网络为主[15,7,17,28,19,18],然而明显的前传.
用于作曲和解释这种系统几乎没有改变:一个高斯人中心,面相 [24],运动 [16]. 焦点作用于静态图像中的突出物体探测[31],模糊的识别方式一直

blocks.en: A defocus map is a region cue whose reliability varies from frame to frame: it marks the subject in a shallow depth-of-field shot but only texture noise in a deep-focus one. We find that, fused unconditionally, the map of a scratch-trained estimator lowers sAUC on every base we tested (Sec. 4.2 ). In this work we therefore treat trust as a per-frame decision. A reliability gate reads three shape statistics of the map and selects the frames on which the estimator is, on average, above chance. This removes the harm and, with a stronger estimator, yields a significant gain in every domain tested, while on rejected frames the prediction equals its base by construction, i.e., selective prediction applied to cue fusion.
blocks.zh: 分焦地图是一个区域提示,其可靠性因相框而异:它以浅浅的地深镜头标出对象,而仅以深焦镜头标出纹理噪声. 我们发现,无条件的熔化,一个刮痕训练的估测器的地图降低了我们测试的每一个基地的SAUC(第4.2条)。 因此,在这项工作中,我们把信任视为一个框架决定。 一个可靠性门读取了地图的三个形状统计,并选择了估计器平均高于概率的帧. 这消除了伤害,有了更强的估算器,在每一个测试领域都会产生显著收益,而在被否决的框架中,预测值等于其构造基数,即有选择地用于提示核聚变.

blocks.en: Across seven cue-estimator pairs under one pipeline, we find that gating helps only where an estimator has an identifiable regime in which it collapses to chance, and not merely where it is weak. Two predictions follow, and both are confirmed. A stronger estimator of the same cue [ 5 , 11 , 13 ] shrinks the regime and turns the removed harm into a significant gain, and domain shift re-opens it, so that on sports the ungated gain flips to a significant harm while the gate stays positive (Sec. 4.3 ). We call the resulting system FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors (Fig. 1 ) in which each prior may abstain, either through its own output or through the gate.
blocks.zh: 在一个管道下,我们发现,只有在一个估计器具有一个可识别的系统时,它才会偶然崩溃,而不只是在它很弱的地方,测量才有帮助。 接下来是两个预测,两个都得到确认. 一个更强烈的同一提示 [5, 11, 13] 的估算器会收缩政权, 并将消除的伤害转化为重大收益, 域位转移会重新打开, 这样在运动上, ungated win翻转为重大伤害, 而大门则保持正值( 第4.3条)。 我们称由此形成的系统为FocusGate,这是一个有门的无目光前传(图1)的集合体,每个前传者可以通过自己的输出或通过大门弃权.

blocks.en:
Leakage-free subsets. TASED-Net, UNISAL and ViNet-S saw these datasets’ training splits, so every row is scored on held-out video only, while ViSAGE, trained on NTIRE 2026 mouse-tracking data, runs zero-shot. The four baselines span 2019–2026 and 3.7M–6.9B parameters. The held-out sets are the Hollywood-2 test split (1,715 frames, 867 videos after 17 undecodable target frames), the UCF-Sports testing directory (993 frames, 47 videos, every third frame up to 40 per video), DHF1K 601–700 (1,175 frames, 100 videos, twelve evenly spaced frames per video minus 25 without a fixation at scoring resolution), and DIEM (168 frames, 84). TASED-Net and ViNet-S consume a 32-frame clip, UNISAL a recurrent state warmed over up to 96 frames. Metrics. We report shuffled AUC (sAUC, tables in %, deltas in points) [ 3 ] with negatives drawn from the fixation distribution of other videos,

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We proposed FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors in which each prior may abstain. Its gate reads three shape statistics of the defocus map and selects the frames on which the estimator is above chance on average. This removes the harm of unconditional fusion and, with a stronger estimator, yields a significant gain in every domain tested. Added to four supervised predictors, the NTIRE 2026 champion among them, the ensemble improves every model’s sAUC in every domain, a pre-registered one included. The gate is specific to defocus, the only cue tested with a collapse regime, and future work will look for reliability statistics of other cues.
blocks.zh: 我们提议了FocusGate, 一个有门的无目光前科合唱团, 每个前科可以弃权。 它的门读取了解焦图的三个形状统计,并选择了估计器平均高于概率的帧. 这消除了无条件核聚变的危害,有了更强大的估计器,在所测试的每一个领域都产生显著收益. NTIRE 2026 年冠军, 除了4个受监督的预测者之外, 这个门是专门用来解开焦点的,是唯一一个通过崩溃制度测试的提示,未来的工作将寻找其他提示的可靠性统计.

blocks.en: 6 Compliance with Ethical Standards
blocks.zh: 6 遵守道德标准

blocks.en: This retrospective study uses only public eye-tracking data, namely Hollywood-2 with the Actions-in-the-Eye recordings and UCF-Sports [ 14 ] , DHF1K [ 26 ] and DIEM [ 16 ] (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0). No new human or animal data was collected and no ethical approval was required.
